metadata.name: Preserved specimen dataset from PS80, PS92, PS106, and PS122 expeditions
metadata.description: A collection of preserved marine specimens collected during several research expeditions (PS80, PS92, PS106, PS122). For each specimen the dataset provides expedition identifiers, sample IDs, collection date, gear type, water depth, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), morphological measurements (e.g., B. saida TL, SL, weight, sex, condition indices), comments, and elevation of the sampling site.
